---
title: "run gsea barrier cell types"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-19"
---


```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
set.seed(1)
```

```{r}
dreamlet_results_selected <- qs2::qs_read("./barrier_cluster_dreamlet_de_results_all_contrasts.qs2")
comparisons_of_interest = dreamlet_results_selected$comparison %>% unique
clusters = dreamlet_results_selected$cluster %>% unique
```

```{r}
# Loop over each contrast
i = 1
gsea_results_list <- list()
for(cur_cluster in clusters) {
  for (contrast in comparisons_of_interest) {
    
    cur_data <- dreamlet_results_selected %>%
      filter(cluster == cur_cluster) %>% 
      filter(comparison == contrast) %>%
      arrange(-logFC)
    
    # Build named gene list (ranked by logFC)
  
    cur_genelist <- cur_data$logFC
    names(cur_genelist) <- cur_data$gene
    cur_genelist <- sort(cur_genelist, decreasing = TRUE)
    
    cur_fgsea = gseGO(geneList = cur_genelist,
                          OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                          ont = "BP",
                          keyType = "SYMBOL",
                          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                          pvalueCutoff = 1,#don't remove any 
                          by = "fgsea",
                          nPermSimple = 50000,
                          seed = TRUE,
                          eps = 1e-50,
                          verbose = FALSE)
    
    if (nrow(as.data.frame(cur_fgsea)) > 0) {
        gsea_results_list[[i]] <- cur_fgsea %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          mutate(contrast = contrast) %>%
          mutate(cluster = cur_cluster)      
        i = i + 1
    }
  }
}


# Combine all results
all_gsea_results <- bind_rows(gsea_results_list)
saveRDS(all_gsea_results, "gsea_results_barrier_cells.rds")
qs2::qs_save(all_gsea_results, "gsea_results_barrier_cells.qs2")
```
